text: My iPhone battery is draining so fast after the update
Please check Battery Health in Settings > Battery and update iOS. If it continues, contact us by DM.
I was charged twice for the same App Store purchase
We can look into duplicate charges in a private message. Please send the order details via DM.
My AirPods will not connect to my iPhone
Reset the AirPods, make sure Bluetooth is on, and pair them again. DM us if that does not help.
How can I reset my Apple ID password?
You can reset it at iforgot.apple.com. We can help further in DM if needed.
My order has not arrived and tracking stopped updating
Please send the order number in a DM so we can check the delivery status.
I want a refund for an accidental subscription
Request a refund at reportaproblem.apple.com. Eligibility is reviewed there.
The screen on my iPhone is cracked
Repair options and pricing are available at support.apple.com/repair. Please DM if you need help finding a provider.
Apple Pay declined when I tried to pay
Check that your billing address and card details are current, then contact your bank if the issue continues.
Can you help me transfer photos to my new iPhone?
Quick Start or iCloud Photos can transfer your photos. See support.apple.com for the setup steps.
I cannot sign in because I forgot my Apple ID email
Find your Apple ID at iforgot.apple.com using your name and email address.
My MacBook is overheating and shutting down
Keep the vents clear and install the latest macOS update. If it shuts down again, contact service.
Where is my trade-in credit?
Trade-in status can be checked at apple.com/shop/trade-in/status. DM the confirmation number if it is missing.
I need to change the shipping address for my order
Send the order number in a DM and we will check whether the shipping address can still be changed.
My iCloud storage is full
Review large backups and photos in iCloud settings, or choose a larger storage plan if needed.
I was locked out of my account after too many attempts
Account recovery is available at iforgot.apple.com. Please do not share your password here.
